meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总指定时间内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理多场会议纪要并形成周报
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes from a date range into structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into weekly reports

howto.what: Claude 会根据你指定的时间范围（如今天、本周、过去7天），自动查询飞书会议记录，获取对应的会议纪要文档链接和内容，然后整理成结构化的汇总报告（如单日概览或周报）。
howto.when: 当用户提出整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾指定时间段内会议内容的需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: Claude 会生成这周会议的汇总报告
Claude 会询问具体时间范围或使用默认7天
Claude 会输出本周会议的结构化报告

howto.what_en: Claude will automatically query Lark meeting records based on a specified time range (e.g., today, this week, last 7 days), retrieve meeting note document links and content, and compile them into a structured summary report (e.g., daily overview or weekly report).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to organize meeting notes, generate weekly meeting reports, or review meetings within a specific time period.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes
say_en.note: Claude will generate a summary report for the week
Claude will ask for a specific time range or use default 7 days
Claude will output a structured weekly report
